chapter: Trent's band: Arkansas, Dallas and the Adolphus
title: Trent takes over the band and A.G. Godley joins
summary: Trent becomes leader, brings in Joe Haymen and Swazey, replaces his cousin on drums with A.G., and they play a summer resort in Muskogee.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: SO AT SOME POINT -------TOOK OVER THE BAND? RIGHT?
Yeah. -------- took over the band and he got Joe Haymen, Swazey and I said his cousin was on drums and he heard A.G. A.G. came down, we went to Muskogee and played in a place called Stem Beach.
IT SOUNDS LIKE A RESORT.
A summer resort, yeah and A.G. impressed everybody, you know he was fantastic
-------KANSAS CITY.
Yeah, so he was really from Fort Smith. We got him from Kansas. He came in the band from Kansas City. In fact he went to college in Kansas.
-------PROBABLY IN LAWRENCE.
No he didn't go to the University, he went to...
KANSAS STATE?
He went to Quindaro. That's where he went.
IS HE DEAD BY THE WAY?
Yeah, he died.
HE'S BEEN DEAD FOR TWO OR THREE YEARS.
Two or three years.
WHERE OUT IN SEATTLE?
Yes.
ONE OF THE GREATEST PLAYERS.
One of the greatest who ever picked up a stick.
HE FIRED HIS COUSIN.
He fired his cousin and put A.G. in there. And nobody blamed him. I don't think his cousin blamed. His cousin was spellbound by A.G.-------
